column3: “Wind of storm” is rendered “storm wind,” and “flashing” as “flashing forth continually”; “something like glowing metal” is NASB’s rendering of a rare word.
“A likeness of a human belonged to them” is rendered “they had human form.”
“Foot” is rendered “legs,” and “sole of the foot” as “feet.”
“Each to the side of its face” is rendered “straight forward.”
“Faces their and wings their” is rendered “Such were their faces”; the Hebrew division is uncertain.
“The likeness of the living creatures, their appearance” is rendered “In the midst of the living beings,” following the LXX.
“For its four faces” is rendered “for each of the four of them.”
“Rainstorm” is rendered “tumult,” and NASB has “abundant waters.”
“Shining substance” is rendered “glowing metal”; the word is rare.
